title: Etale source transport preserves universality of constant arrows
statement:
theorem etaleNormalizationArrow_universal_of_constant
    (Y : Scheme.{t}) {R S : Type (t + 1)} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (q : R →+* S)
    {E : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{t + 1} R)}
    {E' : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{t + 1} S)}
    (d : E ⟶ (normalizationModuleRestrict q).obj E')
    (h : Nonempty (StructuredArrow.IsUniversal (StructuredArrow.mk d)))
    (U : Y.Etale) :
    Nonempty (StructuredArrow.IsUniversal (StructuredArrow.mk
      (etaleIsomorphismNormalizationArrow Y q
        (normalizationConstantArrow Y.smallEtaleTopology q d) U)))

source.place: Tags 06YY and 03ED, scalar extension and inverse image on an etale source

proof.text: Transport the initial structured arrow for d through exact constant realization and the etale slice equivalence. The canonical inverse-image coefficient mate is an isomorphism, and the derived square identities identify the transported arrow with etaleIsomorphismNormalizationArrow.
